preset.name: XML-RPC probe
preset.description: xmlrpc.php access -- the classic pingback/brute-force amplification endpoint.

lesson.how_it_works: xmlrpc.php's system.multicall lets one HTTP request try hundreds of passwords, slipping past login rate limits. system.listMethods (this preset) is the usual first probe.
lesson.defence: Disable XML-RPC if unused, or rate-limit it and block system.multicall.

preset.name: Time-based blind SQL injection
preset.description: Blind SQL injection that proves itself by delaying the response: SLEEP(1).

lesson.how_it_works: No data is returned, so the user asks the database to SLEEP and measures how long the response takes. A delay proves the query ran, and bits of data can then be read one at a time.
lesson.defence: Use prepared statements, and alert on SLEEP/BENCHMARK in requests and on slow queries.
